why: Third-party products rename menus, buttons and plans without notice. A doc that quotes them goes stale the day the vendor ships a redesign, and a link to the vendor's help page breaks or drifts the same way. Describe the capability generically and send the reader to the client's own documentation without a link.

allowedReferences.why: Stable references a doc may link to even beside a vendor name: the protocol specification, runtime downloads and package registries. Kept by decision during the MCP Profile Hub review.
